Hi,

I teach a graduate seminar on AI systems at State University. Several of my students have been experimenting with Jaseci, and I would love to have someone from your team give a 60-minute guest lecture on agentic programming.

Would September 15 or September 22 work for you? The seminar meets 2-4pm Eastern, and remote is completely fine.

Best regards,
Miguel Alvarez
Associate Professor, Computer Science

emails.subject: Quick question | byLLM structured output
emails.snippet: Hi, we are evaluating byLLM for our log triage pipeline. Our log lines look like "ERROR | walker_spawn | context missing" and we want the model to return structured fields. Does byLLM support

full_thread.body:
Hi,

We are evaluating byLLM for our log triage pipeline. Our log lines look like:

ERROR | walker_spawn | context missing
WARN | node_create | slow response

We want the model to return structured fields (severity | component | message) for each line. Does byLLM support typed/structured outputs for this, or do we need to parse the model text ourselves?

Thanks,
Priya Nair
Platform Engineering, DevFleet

key_points_to_address: confirm byLLM supports typed/structured outputs via Jac's type system
briefly explain how (typed function return values, no manual parsing)
offer follow-up help or a pointer to docs

web_search_results.byllm: byLLM is Jaseci's LLM integration framework for the Jac language. Functions can declare typed return values (including structured objects) and delegate implementation to an LLM with the 'by llm()' syntax; the runtime enforces that model output conforms to the declared type, so no manual parsing of model text is needed.
web_search_results.jaseci: Jaseci is an open-source full-stack agentic programming framework built around the Jac language, featuring graph-based program structure (nodes, edges, walkers) and scale-native cloud deployment.
web_search_results.invoice: General guidance: corrected invoices should reference the original invoice number, state the corrected amount, and be issued before the client's payment run deadline.
